calls.title: Ready Media Group & GrowthBook
calls.summary: Ready Media is beginning to utilize GrowthBook for A/B testing, focusing on a user-friendly visual editor that allows for easy implementation and stakeholder buy-in. Currently, the SDK is embedded, but no tests have been conducted. Jamie Muscatel, the Senior Product Manager, prioritizes understanding the experiment setup and process and plans to integrate tests into Jira for engineering follow-up. The new visual editor, highlighted by James Shannon, supports both AI-assisted and manual variant creation with features like Figma integration, pivotal for Ready Media's significant UI changes. The team is on a free tier but aims to upgrade to a pro-tier trial to access essential tools for experimenting and demonstrating value to stakeholders, considering the primary goal is to optimize inquiries for property listings through strategic UI changes.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, visual editor, GrowthBook, Figma integration, feature flag, managed warehouse
